PATTERN: Do not commit anything until user explicitly says 'commit' or 'yes commit' or similar
WHEN: After every code change, even bug fixes, even small ones
WHY: Ned got visibly furious ('CAN YOU STOP FUCKING COMMITING jesus fucking christ') when Claude auto-committed history fixes mid-investigation. He wants to verify things work before code is locked in.
NOTE: This is stricter than the general 'ask before stripping features' rule — applies to ALL commits, not just destructive ones.
